subject: math
description: Model cube volume with unit cubes and use side length to calculate volume.
learningObjectives: Model the volume of a cube using unit cubes
Explain why cube volume can be found by side × side × side
Use the formula V = s³ for cube volume
Calculate cube volume from a given side length
Use cubic units correctly in final answers
prerequisites: Recognize cubic units such as cm³
Know that a cube has equal length, width, and height
